summary: A full review of the product makes every safety feature dependable and keeps your access and data safe from accidental loss.

fixes.title: Stronger protection for the Manager
fixes.text: Security hardening across the Manager, its sign-in, MSP baselines and PIM Activator.
fixes.action: When you create a new Manager, configure its sign-in and choose who may use it: named people or groups, or all member users.

fixes.title: Two admins can no longer overwrite each other
fixes.text: A commit made on data that changed since you loaded it is refused. You are offered a reload that keeps your staged edits.

fixes.title: Break-glass works as promised
fixes.text: While an emergency override is active, approval is switched off on the scoped groups and restored afterwards. Manage Break-glass accounts in Settings; PIM Manager never disables them.

fixes.title: Safety alerts are really sent
fixes.text: Removal budget, account-disable and policy mass-change alerts are now sent, and a failed send is recorded. A disable date in the past now asks for approval first.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Saving departments keeps all their settings, quick-fixes act on the right row, access-review screens show real data, and updates never move an environment backward.
